work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief XXXV raises the Naples confraternity at SS. Cosma e Damiano to an archconfraternity with power of aggregation; LF7037 → LF7040 column change; LF7101 → LF7110 across provenance LF7104 and running title LF7107; complete 2 June 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7026–7026; the source closing at LF7110–7113 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die secunda iunii millesimo octin- gentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. eee Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
